_README: Authority directory for the Hyderabad pilot. Departments below are real bodies; their CATEGORIES are the team's best reading and must be checked. Add real, published complaint email addresses under 'channels' ONLY after you have sent a real test message and recorded the outcome in 'verification_note'. Channels without a verification_note are never used in live mode. 'parent' is the escalation authority. Do not commit addresses you have not verified.

authorities.name: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC)
authorities.notes: VERIFY: which GHMC wing/zone owns each category and the official grievance email for your demo ward.

authorities.name: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply & Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
authorities.notes: VERIFY: official grievance email/contact for water leaks and sewer overflow. Sewer overflow is typically HMWSSB; stormwater drains GHMC.
